items.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber, its first Critical-rated cybersecurity model, for Daybreak Red teams
items.summary: GPT-6 Cyber scores 48.5% on ExploitGym (up from 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber) and found 81 novel high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities. Available via the API and Codex to approved Daybreak Red customers, with a $1B grant for critical-infrastructure defenders.
items.why: The first AI model to earn a Critical cybersecurity rating demonstrates that specialized models can now discover complex, unknown security flaws at scale. The gated-access approach raises the question of whether defenders will get these tools fast enough.

items.headline: Anthropic launches Personal Finance in Claude, letting US subscribers connect bank accounts
items.summary: Pro, Max, and Ultra subscribers in the US can link bank and credit card accounts through Plaid. Claude gets read-only access to balances and up to two years of transactions but cannot move or invest money. Rolling out in beta.

items.headline: Google launches Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash with 15-second video generation and a 30% price cut
items.summary: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generates and edits clips up to 15 seconds with conversational prompts, improved consistency across camera angles, and 720p output at $0.07/sec. Omni 1.1 Flash routes to 1.2 on December 3.

items.headline: Gemini Canvas lets users turn hand-drawn sketches into working interactive apps
items.summary: Users upload a photo of a sketch, select Canvas, and ask Gemini to code the app. The model reads the image, generates code, and shows a live preview. Refinements like color and feature changes happen in real time.

items.headline: Anthropic adds IP allowlisting, remote sign-out, and a security center to Claude Enterprise
items.summary: Organizations can set up to 1,000 IP allowlist entries to restrict API access. The Admin API can sign a member out on all devices. Enterprise plans also gain a security center with centralized controls and inference hooks.

items.headline: OpenAI president Brockman says the company could be IPO-ready in 2027, acknowledges Claude Code lead
items.summary: At a WSJ conference, Greg Brockman said annualized revenue grew 70% quarter over quarter in Q3, driven by enterprise. He admitted OpenAI was not in the conversation on agentic coding, where Claude Code has gained share.

items.headline: Investors push back on Anthropic's $1.5T IPO valuation as tech stocks sell off after midterms
items.summary: Reuters and the WSJ report potential backers doubt the roadshow can start next week as planned. Some investors want a discount below $1.5T, down from an earlier target near $2T. October revenue figures are missing from the updated S-1.

items.headline: OpenAI publishes a community compact and a policy blueprint for AI data center development
items.summary: The compact pledges OpenAI-operated campuses will cover full energy costs, publish water and power data, avoid NDAs with officials, and invest in local hiring. A companion blueprint proposes federal rules requiring the same of other operators.
